title: Kirby Air Ride - Winter’s Unchained FURY ❄️ ~ Frozen Hillside (X-MAS Special Mashup-mix)
description:
❝ 𝐇𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐬𝐞𝐥𝐟 𝐚 𝐦𝐞𝐫𝐫𝐲 𝐇𝐨𝐨𝐝𝐞𝐝 𝐂𝐡𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐦𝐚𝐬! ❞
ㅤ- Hooded Edge, 2025



You all have been nice this Christmas, so you're getting a special arrangement of Frozen Hillside from Kirby Air Ride (ft. way too many songs). Been addicted to Kirby Air Riders for the past few weeks, and I thought it'd be sick to make my X-MAS SPECIAL SNES-MIX another Kirby Mashup. Thought it'd be neat to turn Frozen Hillside into a rock-inspired track heavily inspired by Ruined Castle Corridor & Silver Wolf (from Castlevania: Harmony of Despair & Mega Man Zero 2 respectively).

I never really liked this song growing up, but I've grown to appreciate it way more after playing Kirby Air Riders recently to where it's one of my favorite race track themes from the game.

Important:
ㅤ♠ What's disabled:
ㅤㅤ - "Bonus End" (@7)
ㅤㅤ - "P-Switch" (@12)
ㅤㅤ - Yoshi SFX (@15)
ㅤㅤ - Thunder SFX

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. D Minor (Original Pitch)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. C# Minor (Luna Nights Pitch)
ㅤ3. D# Minor (Silver Wolf Pitch)
ㅤ4. C Minor (Custom Pitch)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Original Echo Delay, but sacrifices SMW-Compatibility (OG Echo)ㅤ[Listening-Only]
ㅤ2. Decreased Echo Delay (LOWER Echo)ㅤ[turned on by default]
